Exploration_sql:
SELECT ZVALUE AS possible_phone
FROM ZSETTING
WHERE ZVALUE REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(\+?1[- .]?)?\(?[2-9][0-9]{2}\)?[- .]?[2-9][0-9]{2}[- .]?[0-9]{4}([^0-9]|$)' UNION ALL
SELECT ZKEY AS possible_phone
FROM ZSETTING
WHERE ZKEY REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])(\+?1[- .]?)?\(?[2-9][0-9]{2}\)?[- .]?[2-9][0-9]{2}[- .]?[0-9]{4}([^0-9]|$)'
PII_Prompt: a US phone number is a 10-digit NANP number (area code + exchange + line) that may be written as 2023133725, 202-313-3725, (202) 313-3725, 202.313.3725, +1 202 313 3725, or 1-202-313-3725

UNION ALL
SELECT ZVALUE AS possible_username
FROM ZSETTING
WHERE ZVALUE REGEXP '\b[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{2,51}\b'
UNION ALL
SELECT Z_UUID AS possible_username
FROM Z_METADATA
WHERE Z_UUID REGEXP '\b[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{2,51}\b'

FROM Z_PRIMARYKEY
